messages:
alex.s: :rotating_light: seeing a spike of 503s on /generate in eu-west1 starting ~11:05. error rate ~18% over last 3m. can we do a quick sync?
maria: on it, joining. do we have a bridge?
alex.s: created bridge: https://converge.redwood.com/bridge/hrt-1805003210 — agenda quick: 1) triage root cause 2) ephemeral rollback vs routing 3) owner + follow-ups
sandeep: grabbing logs now. running `kubectl logs -n prod inference-pod-7f6 --since=5m | grep ERROR` — will paste results in a sec
lee: pinging infra to check autoscaling events and host-level OOMs
jordan: throwing a temporary route to dedicated pool as fallback? need a quick thumbs up from infra
sandeep: logs show repeated `KVCache::evict failed: resource exhausted` and then `500 -> 503 upstream timeout` (snippet):
```
2026-03-17T11:05:12Z inference-pod-7f6 [ERROR] KVCache::evict failed: resource exhausted
2026-03-17T11:05:12Z inference-pod-7f6 [WARN ] upstream request timeout after 10s
2026-03-17T11:05:13Z inference-pod-7f6 [ERROR] request handler crash: runtime error: invalid memory address
```
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03317-01 (priority P1) — responders: @eng-oncall
deploy-bot: Just saw a canary rollback-triggered event for model-serving v2.1.4 -> rolling back to v2.1.2 in eu-west1 (in progress)
maria: joining bridge now https://converge.redwood.com/bridge/hrt-1805003210 :hand:
lee: infra says a memory pressure spike on the shared allocator around 11:04, scaling didn't kick due to quota exhaustion on that cluster
jordan: if rollback finishes cleanly, we should test `/generate` path for 2 minutes before switching traffic back. can someone own canary test?
sandeep: i can run a small-scale throughput test and monitor kvcache metrics — will post results in 2m
alex.s: perfect. owner: sandeep for logs + verification, lee to follow infra quota and scaling, maria to coordinate rollback monitoring. i'll draft postmortem stub after we stabilize.
maria: small ask: please add any useful query snippets here (e.g., datadog/metrics, kvcache counters) so we can repro quickly
sandeep: posting quick metric queries: `sum:kvcache.evictions{region:eu-west1}.rollup(sum,60)` and `avg:upstream.latency_ms{path:/generate}.rollup(avg,10)`
lee: infra is increasing ephemeral GPU quota for the rollback canary — ETA 1m
alex.s: thanks — if rollback succeeds and error rate drops <1% for 5m we close war room and open follow-up RFC for kvcache improvements. :thumbsup:
maria: noted. adding to calendar: follow-up sync 30m after incident close.
ops-bot: Updated INC-2026-03317-01 status: investigating -> mitigation in progress
(bridge comments): alex.s pinned the bridge link and the agenda
